source.publication: 2025 NJ-1040 Instructions (with GIT-1 & 2 Retirement Income, January 2026, and njit6/njit7 web pages where named)
source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 16a, 17, 19, 20a, 27, 28a, 28b, 29: Instr PDF p.16 IRA withdrawals, PDF p.22 line 28a (Line A, Line B and chart), PDF p.22 line 28b and PDF p.23 Worksheet D lines 1-9 with the Maximum Exclusion chart, PDF p.22 line 29; GIT-1 & 2 p.22-24; PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 95,000.00 (IRA distribution 30,000.00 + interest 15,000.00 + dividends 10,000.00 + long-term gains 40,000.00); federal taxable income = 95,000.00 - 17,750.00 federal standard deduction (15,750 single + 2,000 for age 65 or older) = 77,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 16a 15,000.00 + line 17 10,000.00 + line 19 net gains 40,000.00 + line 20a IRA 30,000.00 = line 27 total income 95,000.00; measure 95,000.00, in the 0-100,000 band (keep share 1). Line 28a: age 70; Line A 30,000.00, Line B 75,000.00; lesser = 30,000.00. Worksheet D: line 1 75,000.00 - line 2 30,000.00 = line 3 45,000.00; lines 4-8 0.00; line 9 = 45,000.00, less than the 65,000.00 of other income, so line 28b = 45,000.00 (projection: room 45,000.00, covered income 65,000.00, lesser 45,000.00). Total exclusions 75,000.00, the single maximum. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 95,000.00 - 30,000.00 - 45,000.00 = 20,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 1 + senior 65+ 1,000 x 1 = 2,000.00; line 38 = 2,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 20,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 18,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table A (single/separate) as bands: 18,000.00 x 0.014 = 252.00 = 252.00. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 252 for the 18,000-18,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 18,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 252.00. The IRA was funded only by a rollover from a 401(k), so it has no New Jersey basis (Worksheet C gives nothing excludable).
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
